reasons.claim: Notified 9.99 ha regeneration felling in Uppsala, status notified. Completed felling overlaps only 0.012 ha (0.1%), so the site is not already felled.

One eligible species within 250 m: Goodyera repens (knärot), VU, a vascular plant, forest-associated and site-bound. Its listed threats include lack of dead wood and increased openness of tree-covered land. There are 4 records, nearest 160 m away (uncertainty 15 m, 2020), and the latest is from 2024 at about 226 m (uncertainty 5 m).

Supporting context: NT fungus Hydnellum ferrugineum at 173 m (2020). It is the only site-bound forest NT species within 250 m, so the 3-species NT trigger is not met. NT bird Poecile montanus at 85 m is mobile and supporting only.

Effort is adequate: 489 records within 1000 m against a county median of 113.5 (79th percentile). Within 250 m there are 58 records of 32 species on 11 days, so the records are not a product of sparse recording.

uncertainties: The nearest Goodyera repens records are 160 m or more from the polygon edge, and none are inside it. They do not show it occupies the felling area.
Records come from 2020 and 2024; the current state of the habitat is unknown.
3 records within 250 m were dropped for coordinate uncertainty, and their content is not known.
Euphydryas aurinia (VU, 77 m, 2026) is not classed as forest-associated and does not count toward the rubric.
not_established: That Goodyera repens grows on the notified stand.
Presence or absence of other red-listed species inside the polygon.
That the site is safe to fell, or any legal status of the species.
next_action: Ask a human reviewer to examine the Goodyera repens records (GBIF 2808585379, 4517216395, 4539120772, 4538995778) against the polygon boundary, and consider a field check of the stand and its edges for the species and for dead wood before felling starts.
